roadmap.title: Start a Challenge Mode park
roadmap.description: Place a nursery near the entrance, hatch a starter animal and release it into a fenced exhibit. Grab the Workshop download while the game is new.

roadmap.title: Build exhibits
roadmap.description: Draw many small closed fences while the park is cheap to run until the exhibit counters unlock.

roadmap.title: Grow the park and the animals
roadmap.description: Raise the park rating, open dig sites for the named species, improve welfare, then start breeding and social goals.

roadmap.title: Long tasks and cleanup
roadmap.description: Leave the game running for five hours, upload a build, finish every species, and do the save-wrecking tasks in a throwaway save.

achievements.description: Become bankrupt
achievements.summary: Go bankrupt.

guide.context: This ruins the save. Loans must be repaid with interest.

steps.text: Start a throwaway save.
Spend all your money on buildings and animals.
Take out loans from the park finances if you can, and keep spending until you go bankrupt.

achievements.description: Have 3,000 visitors in the park
achievements.summary: Have 3,000 visitors in the park.

guide.context: Guest arrivals depend on park rating and park appeal.

steps.text: Raise the park rating by finishing the star goals shown in the rating panel.
Keep prices fair and the park pretty to raise park appeal.
Add animals with many Animal Points. Guests visit them more.
Point at the visitor counter on the bottom bar to see how fast guests arrive, and keep going until 3,000 are in the park.

achievements.description: Achieve a 5 Star park in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Reach a 5 star park in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: Park rating is the average of the Animal Rating and the Guest Rating.

steps.text: Open the park rating panel. It lists the goals for the next star.
Meet the Animal Rating goals with healthy animals that have many Animal Points.
Meet the Guest Rating goals, including enough Attraction Points from kiosks, restaurants, binoculars and statues.
Repeat each star until the park reaches 5 stars.

achievements.description: Unlock every animal in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Unlock every animal in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: Open each dig site once, then buy its animals. Every dig site needs money and a minimum park star rating. The list follows the dig sites in the game and may miss species added in the newest updates.

achievements.description: Release an animal into the park
achievements.summary: Release an animal into the park.

steps.text: Build a small @mechanic{Animal Nursery} near the park entrance.
Fence off an exhibit that fits your starter species, with food and water.
Open the nursery menu from Park Services, hatch a starter animal and release it into the exhibit.

achievements.description: Release a male and female of every animal in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Release a male and a female of every animal in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: Male animals need the Induced Androgenesis research node in Biology. Research it before you start. Use the same species as Fossil Record.

achievements.description: Release a Smilodon in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Release a Smilodon in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: Smilodon populator from the @loc{Luján Formation} should also work. The achievement did not trigger before Update 13, so make sure the game is up to date.

steps.text: Unlock the @loc{La Brea Tar Pits} dig site in the Excavations menu and buy Smilodon fatalis.
Build an exhibit with 40–60% forest and up to 30% water.
Hatch the animal in the nursery and release it into the exhibit.

achievements.description: Release a Triceratops in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Release a Triceratops in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: The achievement did not trigger before Update 13, so make sure the game is up to date.

steps.text: Unlock the @loc{Hell Creek Formation} dig site and buy a Triceratops.
Hatch it in the nursery and release it into a suitable exhibit.

achievements.description: Release a Tyrannosaurus in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Release a Tyrannosaurus in Challenge Mode.

steps.text: Unlock the @loc{Hell Creek Formation} dig site and buy Tyrannosaurus rex.
Hatch it in the nursery and release it into a suitable exhibit.

achievements.description: Release a Woolly Mammoth in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Release a Woolly Mammoth in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: The mammoth needs a High strength fence, over 2.5 m tall.

steps.text: Unlock the @loc{Tokod Formation}, @loc{Kozhamzhar Formation} or @loc{Yamal Peninsula} dig site and buy Mammuthus primigenius.
Build an exhibit with 5–25% forest, up to 15% water and a strong fence.
Hatch it in the nursery and release it into the exhibit.

achievements.description: Build 50 Exhibits
achievements.summary: Build 50 exhibits.

steps.text: Draw a closed fence shape. Each closed shape becomes one exhibit.
Keep drawing closed fences until you have 50 exhibits.

achievements.description: Build 100 Exhibits
achievements.summary: Build 100 exhibits.

guide.context: This continues from Exhibit A. Keep the old exhibits standing.

steps.text: Keep drawing small closed fences until you have 100 exhibits.

achievements.description: Hidden achievement. Let waste build up until a paddock reaches 0% cleanliness.
achievements.summary: Have a paddock reach 0% cleanliness.

steps.text: Put several animals that leave visible waste piles, such as two bears, in one paddock.
Leave the waste uncleaned.
Check the paddock cleanliness until it reaches 0%.

achievements.description: Spend 5 hours in a single save
achievements.summary: Play for 5 hours in a single save.

steps.text: Keep playing or idle in one save until its playtime reaches 5 hours. Do not start a new save.

achievements.description: Upload an item to the Steam Workshop
achievements.summary: Upload an item to the Steam Workshop.

steps.text: Build something small, select its group and save it as a prefab.
Upload that item to the Steam Workshop from the game.

achievements.description: Download an item from the Steam Workshop
achievements.summary: Download an item from the Steam Workshop.

steps.text: Open the game's Steam Workshop page and subscribe to one item.

achievements.description: Reach the max exhibit score for 1 habitat in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum exhibit score in 1 habitat in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: Update 13 removed Exhibit Score. The game now rates animals by Animal Points and welfare.

steps.text: Give every animal what it needs: matching plants, water, a stocked feeder and a clean exhibit.
Pick species with high Animal Points and keep them together with species from the same dig site.
Keep improving the habitat until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Reach the max exhibit score for 5 habitats in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum exhibit score in 5 habitats in Challenge Mode.

steps.text: Give every animal what it needs: matching plants, water, a stocked feeder and a clean exhibit.
Pick species with high Animal Points and keep them together with species from the same dig site.
Keep improving the habitat until the achievement unlocks.
Repeat in 5 separate habitats.

achievements.description: Reach the max exhibit score for 10 habitats in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum exhibit score in 10 habitats in Challenge Mode.

steps.text: Give every animal what it needs: matching plants, water, a stocked feeder and a clean exhibit.
Pick species with high Animal Points and keep them together with species from the same dig site.
Keep improving the habitat until the achievement unlocks.
Repeat in 10 separate habitats.

achievements.description: Have over 70% Animal Welfare in a habitat with 5 species in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Have over 70% Animal Welfare in a habitat with 5 species in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: Mixed species from one dig site get a bonus.

steps.text: Choose 5 species that share the same dig site, region and time period.
Build one habitat with plants and water that suit all five species.
Stock the feeders and keep a keeper on waste until welfare is over 70%.

achievements.description: Have over 90% Animal Welfare in a habitat with 25 animals in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Have over 90% Animal Welfare in a habitat with 25 animals in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: Habitats stop breeding when they get too crowded. Keep waste cleaned up.

steps.text: Pick a herd species, such as Dryosaurus.
Build a large habitat with the right plants, water and feeders.
Add animals up to 25 and keep welfare over 90%.

achievements.description: Release a Brachiosaurus in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Release a Brachiosaurus in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: A fully grown Brachiosaurus costs about $38,000 to incubate. Large animals may need larger nursery research.

steps.text: Unlock the @loc{Morrison Formation} dig site and buy Brachiosaurus altithorax.
Build a large exhibit with 20–55% forest and up to 30% water, fenced with Extreme strength fence over 6 m tall.
Hatch it in the nursery and release it into the exhibit.

achievements.description: Have an animal become an ancestor to over 3 generations of offspring
achievements.summary: Have an animal become an ancestor of more than 3 generations of offspring.

guide.context: Raising animals slowly in the nursery gives them higher fertility, and children inherit it.

steps.text: Breed one animal and keep its descendants alive.
Breed each new generation until the first animal has descendants more than 3 generations deep.

achievements.description: Have an animal be naturally born in the park
achievements.summary: Have an animal born naturally in the park.

guide.context: Animals do not breed with close relatives.

steps.text: Research Induced Androgenesis in Biology so you can hatch male animals.
Put at least one male and one unrelated female of the same species in one habitat.
Place a nesting module for that species in the habitat.
Wait for the breeding season, a successful courtship and the eggs to hatch.

achievements.description: Have an animal adopt an unrelated baby
achievements.summary: Have an animal adopt a baby it is not related to.

steps.text: Put a baby animal in a habitat with adult animals.
Wait until an adult adopts the baby.

achievements.description: Have an animal attempt courtship 3 or more times without success
achievements.summary: Have an animal try courtship 3 or more times without success.

steps.text: Put an adult male and female of the same species together before their breeding season.
Watch during the breeding season. Females can reject courtship.
Keep watching until one animal has been rejected 3 times.

achievements.description: Have an animal reach old age without having socialized with any animal
achievements.summary: Have an animal reach old age without ever socializing with another animal.

guide.context: Animals socialize when they can see or hear each other, so keep it out of sight and earshot.

steps.text: Pick a solitary species such as Acrocanthosaurus and keep it alone.
Keep it alive until it reaches old age.

achievements.description: Release a Spinosaurus in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Release a Spinosaurus in Challenge Mode.

guide.context: A fully grown Spinosaurus costs about $31,800 to incubate.

steps.text: Unlock the @loc{Kem Kem Group} dig site and buy Spinosaurus aegyptiacus.
Build an exhibit with 10–60% forest and 40–90% water, fenced with High strength fence over 4 m tall.
Hatch it in the nursery and release it into the exhibit.
